text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The lineup at the spring Tenno Sho isn't anything to sneeze at, even with Oguri Cap and Super Creek not taking part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One braces herself. This isn't just any race, but an important stepping stone on her way to becoming Umamusume of the Year.
